notes.title: Femtazio 1.0.5 Update - Crash fixes and Optimization
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your patience. We have worked out the issues that some players were experiencing the past few days. Thanks for all those players who gave their feedback and reported bugs.[/p][p]
Patch Notes:[/p][olist][*][p]Game should no longer crash due to Out of Memory issue. Players should be able to play the entire game without crashing.[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 3-20 had a problem where if you saved on that stage, you could not load game. You can now load on that stage, Also the game will no longer autosave there.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where sometimes the stages would not end because an enemy spawned off screen and the player could not kill them.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed quite a few unused files to reduce game package size.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
If you are experiencing any other issues, please let me know.[/p]

tags.bug: [p]Game should no longer crash due to Out of Memory issue. Players should be able to play the entire game without crashing.[/p]
[p]Chapter 3-20 had a problem where if you saved on that stage, you could not load game. You can now load on that stage, Also the game will no longer autosave there.[/p]
[p]Fixed the issue where sometimes the stages would not end because an enemy spawned off screen and the player could not kill them.[/p]

tags.feature: [p]Removed quite a few unused files to reduce game package size.[/p]

notes.title: Femtazio 1.0.3 Update
notes.content: [p]First of all, a huge thanks to everyone for their support of Femtazio![/p][p]We had an incredible launch, was on New and Trending for 3 days...and we even climbed BACK on New and trending today for a bit! incredible![/p][p][/p][p]I've been updating the game in the background but I didn't really have time to share the changes. But here's all the changes we had since 1.0.0. Thank you for everyone who gave feedback![/p][p][/p][p][b]1.0.3 Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized file sizes, reduced size.[/p][/*][*][p]New art - Fixed some less good Lisina art and added 2 new pieces in Chapter 5[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the code a to optimize and reduce chance of crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some incorrectly bound buttons. - F12 Steam screenshot works again[/p][/*][*][p]Some buttons were incorrectly bound before and are no longer bounc: such as F, F12 and arrow keys.[/p][/*][*][p]NOTE: Currently there is a known issue where the game has a chance of crashing when it runs for a long time. Restarting the game will solve everything. You should be able to play for over an hour before any crash though. So if you are crashing often its probably something else. Sorry about this issue but we are working hard to resolve it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]1.0.2 Changes[/p][list][*][p]Polished many Hscenes and improved the voices and plap plap plaps[/p][/*][*][p]New kissing animation for Water Nymph mini game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue of Water Nymph's mini game finish button placement[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]1.0.1 Changes[/b][/p][p]Minor bug fix - Chinese Chapter 3-1 is fixed and can progress[/p][p]New Animation! - Colosseum new artwork and animations[/p]

tags.feature: New art - Fixed some less good Lisina art and added 2 new pieces in Chapter 5

tags.bug: Removed some incorrectly bound buttons. - F12 Steam screenshot works again
Some buttons were incorrectly bound before and are no longer bounc: such as F, F12 and arrow keys.

NOTE: Currently there is a known issue where the game has a chance of crashing when it runs for a long time. Restarting the game will solve everything. You should be able to play for over an hour before any crash though. So if you are crashing often its probably something else. Sorry about this issue but we are working hard to resolve it.

tags.bug: Fixed the issue of Water Nymph's mini game finish button placement
Minor bug fix - Chinese Chapter 3-1 is fixed and can progress
